title: A Journal of Impressions in Belgium

It explores themes of duty, fear, and the juxtaposition of beauty and horror in a war-torn landscape. As the team arrives in Ostend, Sinclair's observations emphasize both the beauty of the Flemish countryside and her growing anxiety about the impending conflict.
